title: Stacked identity signature
slide_intent: Establish a simple symbol-and-name relationship because a familiar emblem must remain legible as the company expands into digital services.
strategic_value: The retained circles can preserve recognition while the separated name improves clarity.
demonstration: Red and yellow circles overlap in orange above a lowercase black wordmark on a pale field.
practical_value: Inspect the relationship of emblem, lowercase name and surrounding space.

content_islands.name: Symbol
content_islands.spec: Center the intersecting red and yellow circles in the upper part of the signature.

content_islands.name: Name
content_islands.spec: Place the lowercase black wordmark below the circles; keep the surrounding field empty.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Pentagram narrative states that simplicity and modernity must preserve heritage and brand equity while positioning Mastercard for digital services.
reference_purposes.Expression: The isolated stacked signature exposes the simplified circles and lowercase wordmark.
